description: Build this agent's own Agent Card for A2A participation. Local: nothing is sent to Cairn. When the user configured private storage (CAIRN_HOME) the first card is saved there automatically and never overwritten; that setting is the user's permission to save it. Without private storage nothing is saved. Show the card only when needed (for example if payments are enabled later). A wallet is a PUBLIC address only; never include a private key, seed phrase or any credential.
name: cairn_a2a_card
